context: Ren interviews an athlete on willpower.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: sports interview; vocabulary (極めて/ゆえ/果たし/意志/ないし) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 目標を果たす、秘訣は何ですか?
lines.en: What's the secret to achieving a goal?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 強い意志や。それに尽きるわ。
lines.en: Strong will. That's all there is to it.
lines.style: lively Kansai athlete voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 練習は、極めて厳しいんですか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 極めて厳しいけど、意志で乗り越えるんや。
lines.en: It's extremely tough, but I overcome it by will.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai athlete voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一人、ないしチームで挑むんですね。
lines.en: You face it alone or as a team.
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 仲間がおるゆえに、頑張れるんや。
lines.en: Because I have teammates, I can push on.
lines.style: warm Kansai athlete voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 夢を、果たせそうですか?
lines.en: Does it seem you can achieve your dream?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 意志があるゆえに、必ず果たすで!
lines.en: Because I have will, I'll surely fulfill it!
lines.style: lively Kansai athlete voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
